notes: Fix: the Settings menu (and other panels) could be invisible on phones when the text size was not M
Controller support: Xbox/PlayStation pads on PC, built-in controls on Android handhelds and Bluetooth pads (needs the new APK on Android)
Controller: A talks/uses or jumps, B rolls/back, X interact, Y map, LB/RB zoom, Start menu; D-pad moves through every menu
AYN Thor and other dual-screen handhelds: the bottom screen shows the map (tap a town to ride the train), objective, team, big battle buttons and dialogue history (new APK)
Handhelds: 60 Hz lock and steadier dynamic resolution for smooth play on High
Settings → About: second-screen toggle and device/controller info
